reviews.text: Thank you so much for the 5-star review! We truly appreciate your support and are glad you had a great experience with our team!
Thank you for the review! We really appreciate you taking the time to support our clinic and our team!

This clinic over the years has & continues to have the rudest staff & technicians I’ve ever met at such establishment.  The Doctors are very kind, but their gate keepers are really who the client has to deal with 90 percent of the time.  I’ve put in complaints over the years and I’ve sadly concluded they’ll continue matching my kindness with rudeness & negatively.

I can’t say enough great things about Dr. Rion and the staff at Lincoln Heights Animal Hospital. My dog Zara had been bounced around to different vets with no real direction on how to manage her autoimmune disease and now diabetes.

Dr. Rion took the time to review all of Zara’s history, listen to my concerns, and come up with a clear plan for her care. She was very thorough, patient, and made sure I understood the next steps.

I haven’t had the chance to meet all of the other vets or techs yet, but I’m sure they are just as great. I’m very thankful we found Lincoln Heights Animal Hospital and look forward to making it Zara’s new home.
Great staff and caring Vets. Definitely recommend!

My pup ate a scrub sponge. I was able to come to LH animal hospital for triage. The staff let me know up front cost and there could be a wait. We arrived to a welcoming space. Dr. Radicke was amazing and thoroughly examined my pup. The cost for exam and meds was very reasonable (not like the big box vets). My pup is fine, and what I appreciated most is good care without a bunch of unnecessary tests. High recommended!

This was the first vet I brought my dog to. Burt Reynolds, and they were absolutely amazing. I never had a bad feeling about them and my dog always looked forward to going there. He never shyed away from going there as he did with other vets after I moved from San Antonio. I wish I never had to leave but I was in the military. I feel I should have written this a long time ago. Lincoln Heights showed him nothing but love and care and I believe if I had stayed, Burt would still be alive today. My baby passed on 4/15.  I was told he was in excellent health. And maybe he was. But I wasn't ready to let him go. I thank all of the doctors and vet techs at Lincoln Heights who took such good care of my baby when they had him. I loved him with all my heart and wanted Lincoln Heights to know how important they were and still are to me. I love you guys and still miss you all so much. Thanks for taking care of my baby. Losing him has been devastating for me. But knowing you take such good care of the babies people bring you is comforting. I wanted to let you know. He was everything to me. I would move back to San Antonio just to have Lincoln Heights take care of my babies again. ❤️

I would not recommend Lincoln Heights. My pet was given incorrect vaccines, I was overcharged, and the vet and staff were not gentle with my dog.

My first visit to this office was to get a rabies vaccine for my pet, my second visit was to treat my pet’s hot spots. In the first visit, the vet was kind, but gave my puppy an adult rabies vaccine. This incorrect rabies vaccine would later on prevent my dog from traveling overseas with me for several months. I was also overcharged for this visit and had to get the bill corrected by the staff. During our second visit, the vet was pretty rough with my dog and ended up taking my dog to the back room without me present. Since this encounter, my dog gets anxiety when we visit the vet.

I have been going loyally  for over 30 years to Lincoln’s Heights and have loved them.  A week ago I called to schedule having a kitten neutered. I was told the person that does the scheduling does so from home and would be calling me back to schedule. I waited. No voicemail was left from anyone with Lincoln Heights vet. Today I called to schedule and was told to check my messages and that as far as they were concerned she called me and left a message. So basically, calling me a liar.
I will never take my business there again and told her so. I’ve spent thousands of dollars with them. Referred tons of friends and family.
No more.
We love Lincoln heights animal hospital.  The staff is so wonderful.  We love dr everheart

Dr.Michael is awesome, my dog, he got in, got a few things done and he was handled in such great care from the nurses and the doctor. He is feeling so much better ever since the visit and more happy now. He is even more active so I’ll always recommend this place to everyone I know. God bless Dr.Michael, he is an amazing doctor.

Dr. Everhart neutered our dog and took care of some significant gingival hyperplasia. We were shocked with how big of a difference Dr. Everhart was able to make with our dog’s teeth-we are blown away! The whole process was seamless. Everyone was so intelligent and confident! Their prices were unbeatable, and they even sent home his medication in a bag with his name handwritten and little drawing. All the staff are so sweet, we just couldn’t be happier with our experience here.
Awesome folks and great prices!

Dr. Everhart is absolutely wonderful and has seen Charlie since he was a puppy. Recently, Charlie fractured his front tooth and I was concerned about a possible infection. Charlie's front tooth was extracted to prevent future issues. Scheduling the procedure was quick and convenient. Pricing was very reasonable (I anticipated costs being more than what they were). The staff are always pleasant, which is a definite plus. They were so kind as to customize Charlie's medicine bag! Charlie and I are very thankful for their hard work, dedication, and professional care, and we highly recommend Lincoln Heights Animal Hospital!

We had our awful gray street, cat or stray cat.As you call it of declaw there, they use a laser.It's very humane.They give them an antibiotics.Pain pills and even kitty prozac, these guys are great.They're compassionate reasonably priced.I don't have any pictures, but would I use them again?Absolutely.

We have brought our pets to Dr Radicke at Lincoln Heights for decades.  He and his team are the most dedicated, honorable, kind, professional people you could possibly hope for.  If i could rate Lincoln Heights a 10 I would, but the rating only goes to 5.

My sister, Cindy, and I have taken our pets to Lincoln Heights for years and we have only good reviews to state.  Dr Radicke finally got rid of Noodles problem of mange.  I had seen a vet at Becker Animal Hospital and one in McAllen,Tx., but to no avail.  I hold Dr Radicke very highly.

I will never be able to fully put into words how grateful I am to Lincoln Heights Animal Hospital for saving my cat’s life. A few weeks ago, my sweet girl got into something she shouldn’t have — a giant piece of our air fryer. I had no idea it would turn into a nightmare. It ruptured her stomach not once, but twice, and she had to stay in the hospital for nearly two weeks. Those days felt like years. I was terrified I would lose her.
From the moment we brought her in, the entire staff treated her with such kindness, patience, and compassion. They explained everything to me, gave me constant updates, and loved her like she was their own. I could tell they weren’t just doing their jobs — they truly cared about her and wanted her to pull through as much as I did.
They worked tirelessly through surgeries, recovery setbacks, and long nights to make sure she had the best chance. And because of them, she’s still here. She’s back home, curled up in her favorite spot, purring like nothing ever happened.
I will forever be grateful to every single person who cared for her. They didn’t just save her life — they saved a part of mine too. My cat means the world to me, and because of their skill, dedication, and love, I still get to share my life with her. If you’re looking for a place that will truly go above and beyond for your pet, this is it. They are heroes in every sense of the word.

I recently saw Dr James Everhart for my family’s elderly dog, Bodhi. We had been working with another vet for over a year trying to figure out why Bodhi was suddenly coughing and losing weight. That
vet ran repeated chest x-rays and tried the same medication multiple times without success. At our wits end, we took Bodhi to Dr Everhart. Within 45 minutes, Dr Everhart looked at Bodhi’s labs, did an ultrasound, and diagnosed him with terminal cancer. Dr. Everhart was compassionate and thorough. He listened to my concerns and gave me advice on how to move forward with Bodhi. I will forever be grateful for his help and highly recommend him to anyone who is looking for a competent vet.
Parking is the only issue...come up from the south. Otherwise...Well, it's crossing an intersection catty corner.  Staff was friendly and available.
We take our animals there they are great people and they'll put you on a payment plan which is awesome

Let me start by saying all of my dogs have been going here for years, but this is just too much!
I brought my doodle in for her annual exam. They were nice enough to my dog, but they gave her 5 injections, did blood work for heartworm, which I did not know they were doing and then asked if I needed heartworm/flea pills. I said yes that I needed 2. When I left and they gave me the total bill, it was $645 dollars!!!
I mean that's more than my car payment!! I swiped my cc and she said she would email me the invoice. When I got to work and looked at the bill, they charged me almost $20 just to use my cc.
I don't remember them ever doing that. The flea meds were $200 which is outrageous!! Now she's limping and throwing up.
Will never take her back here again.
They never told me the side effects, she didn't need this DHLPP injection, which I suspect is what made her lethargic. I only needed the influenza and Bordatella required for daycare.
Just be aware of what they are giving your pet, because they do not tell you beforehand or even ask you if you want it.

So grateful for this amazing vet hospital. Long story short I had to bring my dog in on a Friday, Monday, and Tuesday as they monitored my pet and Dr. Radicke even gave me his number to call him on both the Saturday and Sunday in between that time. He walked me through monitoring her for symptoms over the weekend.

Between both Dr. Radicke and Dr. Everheart we’ve had exceptional care like I’ve never had before in my lifetime of owning dogs. They don’t try to overcharge you and you’re able to get in ASAP if your pet needs immediate attention. They really care and although my dog River has been to the vet more than she wants recently…I can even tell she trust them examining her when she’s there.
Everyone is super nice and sweet towards both my pets. Everyone was great at explaining process and answering any questions I had.
I take all my fur baby’s here and I have a great experience every time

Vets, like so many other places, have gone corporate, but not Dr. Radicky’s practice. He resists the tide because he knows the results (and prices) are better for our pets and for our peace of mind. I’m so grateful for the quality of care everyone delivers from the front desk to the assistants. My fur baby is happy, too.

We saw Dr. Radicke for our cats for over 20 years.  The quality of care used to be excellent and our relationship with him was very good.  However, in recent years we have been very disappointed in the quality of care provided.  Dr. Radicke was once a friendly and skilled vet.  His demeanor has changed. Now he's irritable, and he doesn't seem to have the same level of skill he once had.  We hope he will consider retiring and passing his clinic on to a new owner.  We had to move our three cats to a new vet hospital and have been much happier there.

I’ve have two fur babies and I love seeing Dr. Bunning and Dr. Radike here. These two are great vets with great bedside manner, and I love how I can always get my fur babies in quite quickly, especially when they’re sick.

An animal hospital that feels like family. I truly trust the Veterinarians, techs, and staff here,  and I know any discerning pet parent can also.  The people here are always friendly and the office is extremely well managed.
Great veterinary that cares about your pets and loved ones. Love them...

Our 14 yr old Chihuahua has been battling cancer. She took a turn for the worse over the weekend. We knew it was time to let her go. Our regular vet was closed for the Christmas Holidays. We called Lincoln Heights and the said they would be glad to help us . Dr Everhart helped Coconut cross over the bridge. He is outstanding! Would highly recommend Dr Everhart and Lincoln Heights!
Very helpful staff and Vets are very caring and understanding.

Horrible experience! I took my cat in for an annual and a few vaccinations. The technician scruffed my cat and after I asked not to do that, the vet tried to educate me that it is the proper way to handle a cat. However, if you do ANY kind of research you would know scruffing a cat that is not a KITTEN can be very traumatizing and cause intense fear and anxiety. The tech after that was very rude and didn’t even tell me if I was good to go. I had barely any communication about my cat’s health after the vaccinations. My cat did not even get weighed or her tummy pressed on at an “annual visit”. A horrible visit then costed over 100$. This vet office may been good with dogs but I recommend if you have a cat to take them elsewhere.
They have always helped me take excellent care of my pets.  I appreciate the flexibility in making appointments.  Thank you!!

After moving from out of state, we needed to find a new vet for our dog. We were very pleased with our initial appointment with Dr. Everhart. He was straightforward and recommended a course of action. We ended up scheduling Maya for a dental cleaning and extraction which went very well. I love how someone always answers the phone at this clinic. Additionally, today my dog was having a more emergent condition so I was able to have a standby appointment. I really appreciated the clinic calling me back to let me know that they received a last minute cancellation so I could move to that slot vs the waiting as a walk in. Dr. Radicke explained his diagnosis and gave a clear course of action for Maya. The prices at this clinic are incredibly reasonable too. 10/10 so happy we found this clinic and know Maya is in good hands.

The staff and Dr. Radicke are the best. Our black lab had her annual Dental at Lincoln Heights and she is doing well the 2nd day. Thank you for taking outstanding care of my dog. In addition to her Dental, Nova also had a small growth removed. Dr. Radicke and his staff contacted us several times to update us on her surgery and recovery. I appreciate their attention to detail in regards to my dog. You all are fantastic, thank you again.
Used to take my grandfather's dog here, now I take mine here. They're nice, answer the phone quickly, professional and knowledgeable.
Everyone was kind and compassionate!

Dr. Everheart saved my dog's life.
Lincoln Heights Animal Hospital fit me in as a walk-in when my 15-year-old Shar Pei mix was not acting herself. Instead of writing her off as old, Dr. Everheart took his time asking questions, doing a thorough assessment, explaining his thoughts, going over options, and making the most cost-effective and important decisions. The labs he deemed most important revealed an infection that needed antibiotics, which most definitely saved her life. He also prescribed her 3 days of pain medication that alleviated her suffering, a much-needed relief for me. The workup and treatment were exactly what was needed and nothing extravagant or unnecessary. He also talked with me twice after our visit to check on how she was doing. My baby girl is now on the road to recovery for however much longer this life has in store for her. Thank you Dr. Everheart and Lincoln Heights Animal Hospital!

This is my first experience with puppy ownership and having my own pet in the home. I took my 9 week old Golden for a wellness check (the insurance I chose for her required it). The staff and Dr. Bunning were incredible. So friendly and …

This is my vet! I always bring my 3 dachshunds here and they receive excellent care. One of my babies recently had an intestinal partial blockage from eating mulch and the Doctor was so attentive and caring. He even came in thr next day and …
